hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.css|*.vue|*.html|*.md|*.yaml|*.yml) pnpm exec prettier --write "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
